blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The FIVB and Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC) have recognized the new Philippine National Volleyball Federation (PNVF) board, led by president Frank Lao. Lao, who was elected with the new board last August, received the official recognition from the FIVB in a letter dated November 2. “Reference is made to the election process at the Philippine National Volleyball Federation in which Mr. Frank Lao was elected President,” the FIVB wrote. “The FIVB Legal Department reviewed the documentation submitted by your National Federation in accordance with Article 1.6 of the FIVB General Regulations.” READ: PNVF, Frank Lao apologize after Alas […]...
